params.body:
Dropping a post on the lead (#52) jumped back: the moment the drag ended, the page drew the old lead again, then switched to the new one once the pipeline had saved the pin and the posts had reloaded. On the live Studio that round trip takes long enough to read as "it did not work".

## Change

- A post dropped on the lead, or placed there with "Place on the page", stays drawn as the lead (`leadSettling`) until the change is done and the page has reloaded with it. A failure puts the page back as it was and says so. The trends have worked this way since #51.

## Checked

- In a local preview (headless Chromium, stand-in pipeline), every change of the lead was recorded while a post was dragged slowly across the lead's title, byline and buttons and then dropped:
  - before: the lead switched to the dragged post, back to the old lead on the drop, then to the dragged post again;
  - now: it switches once, when the post comes over the lead, and stays.
- `npm test`: 42 of 42 pass. `npm run build` is clean.
params.title: Front page: a post dropped on the lead stays there while it is saved
